verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a web tag/snippet and a Segment-API-compatible JS integration (implying track/identify/page methods) plus an HTTP API for server-side/backend event sends, which covers web and server collection with a documented spec inherited from Segment's API. However, there is no evidence of official mobile SDKs (iOS/Android) or a Jitsu-authored tracking spec document distinct from riding on Segment's API compatibility. Missing for 10: mobile SDK support, explicit first-party documented track/identify/page spec reference, independent corroboration of SDK behavior across platforms.
